description:
Every case leaves a record. A 911 call. A security camera. An interrogation tape. A DNA file nobody expected to come back.

The Tape Knows goes through that record, piece by piece.

Two kinds of case live here. The viral disappearances you think you already know, where the footage shows something the official explanation never covered. And the interrogations, where a trusted cop, a pastor, a devoted spouse sits down believing the police have nothing, and the evidence is already in the next room.

Every video is built only from officially released material: surveillance footage, bodycam, 911 audio, court filings, interrogation video. Sources are named on screen. Theories are labelled as theories. Nobody who hasn't been convicted is called guilty here.

No gore, no screaming. The unease comes from the gap between what the recording shows and what everyone was told.

New case every week. Long form, around 35 minutes, made to be watched at night.
